name: record-handover
title: Record handover: internal draft
for_each: select id,name from records order by name

sections.title: Originals
sections.sql: select version,original_name,sha256,bytes,actor,evidence from versions where record_id=$1 order by version

sections.title: Preservation holds
sections.sql: select name,reason,imposed_by,released_at,release_evidence from holds where record_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Change history
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from events where record_id=$1 order by created_at,id

name: retention-review
title: Retention review: no destruction authorised
for_each: select id,name from records order by name

sections.title: Current decision
sections.note: The owner must confirm legal obligations, holds and every copy before deciding what to retain.

sections.title: Review evidence
sections.sql: select revision,version,outcome,actor,evidence,next_review,created_at from reviews where record_id=$1 order by created_at,id

sections.title: Follow-up work
sections.sql: select name,owner,due,completed_at,evidence from tasks where record_id=$1 order by due
